statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-61143: a NULL pointer dereference in TIFFFileName() (libtiff/tif_open.c) when the tiffcrop tool reports an error before its output file is open; the fix passes a placeholder name instead of the NULL handle in tiffcrop and also checks the image width against the scanline size in tiffdither (https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/issues/737). Upstream fixed it in https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/commit/4d28af5fe61b1760f10981f5072ff1e6fd44f210 (LibTIFF 4.7.1). Debian has not fixed it for trixie and rates it as a crash in a command-line tool with no security impact (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-61143). The DHI tiff packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie tiff 4.7.0-3+deb13u2 and 4.7.0-3+deb13u3. Every published DHI build, from the first rebuild of 4.7.0-3+deb13u2 on, applies that upstream commit unchanged, and the Debian changelog shipped in the current tiff packages (read for amd64 and arm64) carries a DHI entry that lists CVE-2025-61143 among the backported upstream fixes. The fixed version is therefore the first published DHI tiff build.
